# mixing

> Tools for video and audio editing


## Pages in this subsection

- [mixing](mixing.html.md): Tools for video and audio editing.
- [mixing.audio](mixing.audio.html.md): Audio mixing and editing functionality.
- [mixing.audio.audio_ops](mixing.audio.audio_ops.html.md): Audio editing via slicing interface.
- [mixing.audio.audio_util](mixing.audio.audio_util.html.md): Audio utility functions.
- [mixing.audio.beats](mixing.audio.beats.html.md): Beat / downbeat / onset analysis of an audio signal — the &#96;mixing&#91;beats&#93;&#96; primitive.
- [mixing.audio.segmentation](mixing.audio.segmentation.html.md): Split a long audio into segments — for example, the individual songs in a
- [mixing.chapters](mixing.chapters.html.md): Detect chapter markers from a transcript — platform-agnostic.
- [mixing.dubbing](mixing.dubbing.html.md): Text-to-speech dubbing: re-voice or translate a video from its SRT.
- [mixing.dubbing.dub](mixing.dubbing.dub.html.md): SRT-driven dubbing: replace a video’s audio with TTS narration.
- [mixing.dubbing.srt](mixing.dubbing.srt.html.md): SRT translation for dubbing — built on the canonical &#96;mixing.srt&#96;.
- [mixing.dubbing.tts](mixing.dubbing.tts.html.md): ElevenLabs text-to-speech (TTS) HTTP client.
- [mixing.egress](mixing.egress.html.md): Canonical &#42;egress&#42;: route a produced result to its destination.
- [mixing.errors](mixing.errors.html.md): Typed errors &#96;mixing&#96; raises — the home for exceptions a caller may want to catch.
- [mixing.srt](mixing.srt.html.md): Canonical SRT / timeline parsing and formatting (pure, dependency-free).
- [mixing.transcript](mixing.transcript.html.md): Transcript-driven media editing.
- [mixing.transcript.fillers](mixing.transcript.fillers.html.md): Filler-word detection over Scribe-shaped word lists.
- [mixing.transcript.formats](mixing.transcript.formats.html.md): Transcript output formats: SRT, plain prose, time remapping.
- [mixing.transcript.media](mixing.transcript.media.html.md): ffmpeg-backed audio extraction and timeline-cut application.
- [mixing.transcript.persist](mixing.transcript.persist.html.md): Reuse-or-create the SRT that lives next to a media file.
- [mixing.transcript.pipeline](mixing.transcript.pipeline.html.md): High-level filler-removal pipeline.
- [mixing.transcript.scribe](mixing.transcript.scribe.html.md): ElevenLabs Scribe (speech-to-text) HTTP client.
- [mixing.util](mixing.util.html.md): General utilities for mixing video, audio, etc.
- [mixing.video](mixing.video.html.md): Video tools
- [mixing.video.genai](mixing.video.genai.html.md): AI Video Generation with Google Vertex AI Veo
- [mixing.video.gif](mixing.video.gif.html.md): Animated-GIF export via ffmpeg’s two-pass palette pipeline.
- [mixing.video.thumbnail](mixing.video.thumbnail.html.md): Thumbnail / cover-image generation from a video frame.
- [mixing.video.video_concat](mixing.video.video_concat.html.md): Video concatenation utilities with smooth transitions.
- [mixing.video.video_ops](mixing.video.video_ops.html.md): Video cropping via slicing interface.
- [mixing.video.video_subtitles](mixing.video.video_subtitles.html.md): Video utilities for subtitle embedding and video processing.
- [mixing.video.video_util](mixing.video.video_util.html.md): Video utils.
